title: Estimated Contribution Assessment: Calculation of the Estimate
content:
**Calculation.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the estimate for an unfiled quarter is the average taxable wages of the original reports filed within the recent report months, times the class's estimated assessment uplift, times the contribution rate on the account, rounded to the cent.

| Element | Value or source |
|---|---|
| Recent report months | 12 |
| Reports that count | Original reports only, by their filing dates |
| Average taxable wages | The taxable wages of those reports added together, divided by the number of those reports |
| Uplift | The class's estimated assessment uplift, a figure of the account's financing class |
| Rate | The contribution rate on the account |
| Rounding | To the cent, once, on the final amount; the average and the intermediate products are not rounded |

## How the window is counted

The 12-month window is counted in whole months back from the day the estimate is booked, by the filing dates of the reports. An average taken over a window in which no original report was filed is zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical account)

The estimate is booked on 15 August 2026. Within the 12 months before that day the employer filed three original reports, with taxable wages of USD 40,000.00, USD 52,000.00 and USD 45,500.00. An amended report filed in the same months is left out, because only original reports count. The contribution rate on the account is 0.0310, and the class's estimated assessment uplift is taken as 1.25.

1. Taxable wages added together: USD 137,500.00.
2. Average over the three reports: 137,500.00 divided by 3 is 45,833.3333 (not rounded).
3. Multiplied by the uplift of 1.25: 57,291.6667.
4. Multiplied by the rate of 0.0310: 1,776.0417.
5. Rounded to the cent: **USD 1,776.04**.

## Points of judgement

- **A report filed outside the window.** In the example, an original report filed on 20 June 2025 lies more than 12 whole months before 15 August 2026 and is not part of the average; a report filed on 3 September 2025 is.
- **No original report in the window.** The average is zero, and the estimate works out to USD 0.00.
